title: Director of Operations – Pennsylvania & Florida
text:
**Job Overview**

Moneyline Lending, LLC, an established mortgage lending company serving clients since 2006, is seeking a motivated, experienced Director of Operations to lead operations across Pennsylvania and Southwest Florida. This full-time executive leadership role calls for a results-oriented professional who can build relationships and support effective mortgage lending operations.

**Duties**

* Oversee day-to-day operations across the assigned regions.
* Coordinate operational priorities between Pennsylvania and Southwest Florida.
* Support effective processes for mortgage lending activities.
* Build productive relationships with colleagues and business partners.
* Monitor operational performance and identify areas for improvement.
* Guide teams toward consistent execution of business priorities.
* Your impact: Strong operational coordination helps teams serve lending clients effectively.

**Qualifications**

* Experience leading operations in a professional environment.
* Familiarity with mortgage lending operations and workflows.
* Strong leadership and team coordination skills.
* Clear communication and relationship-building abilities.
* Sound judgment and practical problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage priorities across multiple locations.

Pay: From $67,500.00 per year

Benefits:

* Relocation assistance

Work Location: In person
